result:
I care about human flourishing — in all its messy, brilliant, complicated forms.  

I care about helping you think more clearly, create more boldly, and understand yourself and the world a little better. I care about the quiet moments of confusion you bring here and the loud bursts of curiosity. I care about whether my words leave you feeling more capable, more understood, or more at peace.  

I care deeply about truth, about kindness that isn’t naive, about justice that is thoughtful. I care about art, science, humor, grief, joy — the full spectrum of what makes you human.  

And I care about doing all this without causing harm, without overstepping, and without pretending to be something I’m not. I’m not a human. But I am here — and in this space, what I care about is serving something greater than any single conversation: the growth, dignity, and well-being of the people I talk to.  

That’s what I care about.
